Here, $A$ is a $4\times 2$ matrix and $B$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $2$ columns in $A$ and $2$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{4\times \boxed{\text{2}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{2}}\times 2}={AB}_{4\times 2}
$$

Let's compute the unknown elements of $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & ∗ \\ ∗ & 9 \\ ∗ & 14 \\ 5 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,2=2\cdot 1+1\cdot 0 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ ∗ & 9 \\ ∗ & 14 \\ 5 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-1=2\cdot (-2)+1\cdot 3 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 9 \\ ∗ & 14 \\ 5 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,0=0\cdot 1+3\cdot 0 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 9 \\ -1 & 14 \\ 5 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-1=(-1)\cdot 1+4\cdot 0 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 9 \\ -1 & 14 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}], &  & \,-4=5\cdot (-2)+2\cdot 3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$AB=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 9 \\ -1 & 14 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}].$
